author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You don't have to review the code generated by AI, but you HAVE to review all the skills used by AI, whether you vibe code it yourself or you download it from somewhere.   Also put the link to the original source document in the skill reference as a fall back path.

I just spot stupid Claude make a very stupid mistake in a skill I created a few weeks ago, that gave me lots of headache debugging the code it generates in the past week.   Claude misinterpreted the original document slightly different than my human understanding; it results in a very subtle bug that the behavior of the code looks the same on the outside, that's why it slight thru the testsuite, but NOT doing in the exact correct order.
